data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for FractalUp Radar observability service.
data.what_it_does: Collects and delivers application telemetry including logs, errors, metrics, RUM views, and HTTP tracking to FractalUp Radar. Supports automatic and manual instrumentation, offline queues, and distributed tracing.
use_when: You use FractalUp Radar for observability and error tracking in your Flutter application
You need automatic RUM tracking, error capture, and HTTP instrumentation
avoid_when: You are using a different telemetry provider like Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, or Datadog
You do not require cloud observability and error monitoring
strengths: Comprehensive observability covering logs, metrics, exceptions, and RUM
Supports offline event queuing and durable delivery
Provides migration compatibility layers for existing monitoring SDKs
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the FractalUp platform
Native features like continuous profiling and real session replay require custom platform integration
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring ingestion keys and endpoints via --dart-define during build, and initializing FractalUp.init in main.dart.
